title: Ordinary structural exceptional unit transport
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell$ different from its characteristic and a normalized realization family $R$ [def-sf-native-exceptional-forgetful-data]. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type model, $a_0:X_0\to s_0=\operatorname{Spec}k_0$ its structural morphism, and $a:X\to s$ its geometric base change. Let $S,c$ be any normalized coefficient exceptional system and compactification of $a$, and $S',c'$ the corresponding data for the literal geometric structural map $a_X:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. Then $\rho_X(G_{S,c}(\Omega_s))\simeq\rho_X(G_{S',c'}(\Omega_{\operatorname{Spec}k}))$. Both units are the specified scalar-normalized common-stage coefficient units. This concerns only ordinary constructible operations and has no native adjunction hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply Over.w to the geometric base-change morphism. Its target structure map is exactly pointGeometricIso.hom, so geometricMap(a0) followed by this isomorphism is the literal structural map. Apply constructible_compact_support_target_iso to S,c and S',c' with this equation to compare the left functors.

Apply isomorphismFieldTransport to pointGeometricIso.hom. Identify its residue invertibility instances with those supplied by R using subsingleton equality. Its two epsilon isomorphisms identify pullback along the point isomorphism and pullback along its inverse as inverse functors. Equivalence.mk and toAdjunction give the ordinary pullback adjunction. Compose this with S''s displayed adjunction and transport its left functor through the preceding comparison. Uniqueness of right adjoints gives G_{S,c} ≅ (pointGeometricIso.inv)* ⋙ G_{S',c'}.

Evaluate that natural isomorphism at omega on the geometric model point. R.unit_spec for the inverse point isomorphism identifies its pullback with geometricPointOmega, the normalized unit on literal Spec(k). Map this unit isomorphism through S'.G, compose, and apply rho_X.mapIso. This proves exactly the original Nonempty isomorphism without a native adjunction.

proof_origin.place: Final exceptional-adjunction sentence and structural specialization; Y3 formalized the point geometry, inverse-pullback adjunction, uniqueness of right adjoints, normalized unit transport and realization. Ordinary compact-support target transport is the named remaining step.

lean.statement:
theorem native_exceptional_structural_transport (R : Family l D)
    (X : Space D) (a₀ : X.base ⟶ (point D).base)
    [IsSeparated a₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType a₀.left] [QuasiCompact a₀.left]
    (S : CoefficientSystem D l a₀) (c : Compactification (geometricMap D a₀))
    (S' : StructuralSystem D l X) (c' : Compactification (geometric D X).base.hom) :
    Nonempty ((rho D l R X).obj
        ((S.ring.operation c .closed).G.obj (omega D l R (point D))) ≅
      (rho D l R X).obj
        ((S'.ring.operation c' .closed).G.obj (geometricPointOmega D l R)))
